notes: The Save button in the loader section now sits below the fields it saves, instead of above them with six unrelated controls in between. From the text rows there was no visible way to save, which made the text feature unusable even though…
It also says what it covers - the timing, the loader choice and the text rows - rather than leaving you to guess its reach.
The text rows still save as you type, added in the previous build. Between the two, typing words and having them stick no longer depends on finding a button.
